integrity: The proof independently derives the distributional limit of the normalized circular Morera operator by Fubini, a test-function Taylor expansion, and mollification. The scale and sign agree with the smooth Green-formula normalization in the primary source. No numerical experiment is used and no inaccessible source is asserted not to cover the claim.
scientific_limitations: The result replaces pointwise continuity by local integrability and an averaged L1-in-the-center defect. It does not claim pointwise convergence for L1_loc data, does not identify the weakest possible defect topology, and leaves an explicit literature risk from older general convolution-equation theory whose full text was not accessible.
title: An averaged infinitesimal Morera theorem for locally integrable data
